{NAME} {VERSION} for Windows (64-bit VST3) - NEWSPEECH
https://www.newspeechsound.com

INSTALL
  Copy the "{NAME}.vst3" folder to:
      C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3
  then rescan plug-ins in your DAW (Ableton Live, Reaper, Bitwig, FL Studio,
  Studio One, Cubase...). It shows up as {NAME} by NEWSPEECH.

STANDALONE
  "{NAME} (standalone).exe" runs the plug-in on its own, no DAW needed.
  Pick your audio interface under Options.

The plug-in is not code-signed. DAWs load it without complaint; Windows may
warn the first time you open the standalone .exe (More info > Run anyway).
